theme.description: Enterprise-grade high-contrast theme focused on data clarity, readability, and authority. Follows the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype. Uses solid structural greys with Sapphire Blue accents for actions.

scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100
scale.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl tracking-tight font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100
scale.labels: text-xs tracking-[0.05em] uppercase font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

rules: Overlines and table headers MUST be uppercase, tiny, with tracking-wider.
Never use Inter for headings. Use it exclusively for body text to ensure maximum legibility in dense data tables.
Color is for function only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome structural greys.
Only use Primary color (Sapphire Blue) for CTAs, active states, and key data points.
Ensure text below 18px maintains 4.5:1 contrast, and large text maintains 3:1.
Never use pure #000000. Use tinted greys like #0f172a.

dashboard.sidebar: w-64 fixed h-screen border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900

rules: Direct Children Only: Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.
Cards and widgets must stretch to fill their grid cells (h-full).
Use optical alignment for icons and text in sidebars.

cards.style: Flat Solid surfaces. No heavy shadows.
cards.classes: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg shadow-sm

headers.classes: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800

rules: NO transparent backgrounds under text-heavy areas.
Use a 1px solid stroke to define surface edges, do not rely solely on shadows.

tables.style: Dense padding (py-2 px-4), hover state on rows, sticky header.
tables.action: Right-aligned action menus using Shadcn DropdownMenu.

forms.library: Shadcn UI Form, Input, Select, Checkbox
forms.style: Left-aligned labels, subtle focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary).
forms.date_picker: Shadcn Calendar + Popover (Never native input type=date).

navigation.style: Left sidebar for desktop, hidden on mobile behind a hamburger menu. Top header for user profile and notifications.

rules: DO NOT use 'transition-all'. Target specific properties.
Keep animations fast and subtle. Dashboards are for efficiency, not slow reveals.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-link').
Focus states must have higher contrast than default.
Use explicit hover text colors (hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900).

icons.usage: Use crisp, consistent stroke widths (usually 2px) and sizes.

general: Build a COMPLETE production-ready CRM and Sales Management Web Application.
This is NOT a UI mockup. Implement fully functional real database-backed operations.
Match the reference application's workflows and modules, maintaining service-layer boundaries.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with borders and z-index hierarchy.
Use 2x more padding inside cards and modals than feels comfortable.
Do NOT center align the app container. Dashboards are left-aligned.
Never use AI assistant Emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use pills and modern input fields instead of generic html elements.
Remember to include proper 'data-testid' for all inputs and buttons.
